study_identification_part.si_4_title: Judged by your neighbors: A novel framework for personalized assessment of brain structural aging effects in diverse populations

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study uses NAKO (German National Cohort) for training the normative models. Testing and clinical validation are performed using ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative), AIBL (Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study of Aging), OASIS-3 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies 3), and NIFD (Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative). The MACS (Marburg-Münster Affective Disorder Cohort) is also used for stability analysis but is not listed in the guidance table.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Our study includes data from the German National Cohort (NAKO), the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), the Münster-Marburg Affective Disorder Cohort (MACS), the Australian Imaging, Biomarker Lifestyle Study of Aging (AIBL), the Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative (NIFD), and the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies 3 (OASIS3).

answer.NAKO: normative training for N3, NM, and BAG models

answer.ADNI: testing (MCI, AD, HC) and stability evaluation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: NAKO provides the large-scale healthy reference sample for training. ADNI, AIBL, OASIS3, and NIFD provide clinical groups (MCI, AD, FTD) and their respective controls for benchmarking and validation. MACS and a subset of ADNI are used specifically for testing the stability of the N3 marker.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: The training data for fitting models... comprised 30,047 samples from the population-based NAKO cohort... To investigate each normativity marker's effectiveness... additional data involving 5,857 participants were utilized, sourced from ADNI, AIBL, OASIS and NIFD datasets... Validation subsets included n=835 healthy control participants from the MACS study... and an additional n=1073 healthy older adults from the ADNI study.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Leenings2024.pdf.md: Methods / 5.2.1 Training and Test Data / Data for Stability Analysis, L424-L443

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Training phase uses 29,883 healthy controls from NAKO. Overall phase includes all healthy controls used across training, testing, and stability analysis (NAKO: 29883; ADNI: 1073; AIBL: 368; OASIS3: 1643; NIFD: 263; MACS: 835). Total HC = 34,065. Combined with 2,831 patients, this matches the total N of 36,896 reported in the abstract.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Using MRI data of 36,896 individuals... All normative models are trained with neuroimaging data... of 29,883 individuals... evaluated in 7,013 individuals... Test Data... involves 5,857 participants... NAKO HC n=29883.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Leenings2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L25; Results, L81-L82; Table 2, L500

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase age is from the NAKO HC group. Overall-phase stats are calculated as weighted mean and pooled SD from all HC groups (NAKO, ADNI, AIBL, OASIS3, NIFD, MACS). Min/max ages are restricted by study exclusion criteria.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Exclusion criteria were applied based on age; participants younger than 22 years or older than 72 were omitted... NAKO HC Mean Age 48.45 ± 12.09.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Leenings2024.pdf.md: Methods / 5.2.1 Training and Test Data, L416; Table 2, L500

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Train-phase (NAKO HC): 13,201 females (44.18%). Overall-phase includes female counts from NAKO (13201), ADNI HC (634), AIBL HC (217), OASIS3 HC (1028), NIFD HC (148), and MACS HC (528), totaling 15,756 females out of 34,065 controls.
